description: This Java source file defines the class 'ProductDisplayWorker' which provides utility methods for retrieving related products, quick reorder functionality, and product sorting within the context of an e-commerce shopping cart. It includes methods to fetch random cart products, generate quick reorder product lists based on order history, and order products by custom metrics, indicating its role in product display and recommendation logic.

classes.name: ProductDisplayWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for displaying products, managing related product suggestions, quick reorder functionalities, and custom product sorting for an e-commerce application.

methods.name: getRandomCartProductAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves a random selection of associated products related to the items in the shopping cart, optionally filtering by view allow category, to suggest complementary or cross-sell products.

methods.name: getQuickReorderProducts
methods.description: Generates a list of products recommended for quick reorder by analyzing the user's past order history, applying filters based on category view permissions, and ranking products based on purchase frequency and quantity.

methods.name: productOrderByMap
methods.description: Sorts a list of products based on a specified map of criteria, in either ascending or descending order.
